description: Macao SAR Government data open platform (澳門特別行政區政府數據開放平台) is a data portal run by Macao SAR Government. The platform lists open data sets of the Macao Government in traffic, meteorology, geoinformation, energy and public facilities, with downloads and APIs. Coverage: Macao SAR. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, json, api; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search.
